features.title: Make single-block Linear Search Teaching excellent
features.behavior: Linear Search Teaching should keep runtime state, visualization, generated code, highlighting, and explanation synchronized across run, step, reset, and level switches.

features.title: Generalize the teaching engine so Level 4 rides shared logic, not a one-off
features.behavior: Extract the narration/highlight logic that currently only understands the single canned Linear Search instruction sequence into something that walks any valid instruction-model program (loop, compare, if, return) generically. Level 4 block-built Linear Search should work through this shared engine, not bespoke wiring, and the single-block flow from F001 must keep working through the same code path with no new special case.

features.title: Clarify Binary Search support and feedback
features.behavior: Binary Search should avoid fake Teaching support and, when implemented, explain the current comparison, decision, and remaining search interval without stale text from previous runs. This should be implemented on top of the F002 shared engine, not a second bespoke engine.

features.title: Add VCR-style trace transport (step-back, jump-to-start, jump-to-end)
features.behavior: The app already stores the full frame trace and renders clickable past steps. Add transport controls so a learner can move to any prior step without re-running the program, matching VisuAlgo-style scrubbing.
